response.answer: No. Based on your prior experience, two Thursday evening rehearsal panels before an 08:30 transit-budget press conference left your voice thin enough that the deputy had to take the final responses. The written Q-and-A grid plus recorded samples can let speakers identify only difficult answers for a brief live check, reducing late screen-and-speech work; that also aligns with your physician’s emphasis on regular sleep during migraine recovery. I would prioritize the written review and one focused live check, rather than moderate both evening panels.
